Commentary: Jofra Archer to Cooper Connolly, no run, good length delivery just outside off stump, Connolly defends from the crease

Jofra Archer to Cooper Connolly, FOUR, driven! Lovely shot! Full and swinging away outside off stump, Connolly covers that and plays a neat drive with a slightly open bat face and Archer will not like that
Jofra Archer to Cooper Connolly, no run, beaten on the drive! Now he looks to drive without moving his feet and misses it completely. Realizes he is lucky to survive that full delivery

Jofra Archer to Cooper Connolly, 2 runs, that's an ugly shot and it gets ugly for Banton as well. Never easy running back and look up at the ball and then he had to circle. Literally turned 180 degrees as he couldn't judge it and it fell to his left with his outstretched hand. Looks like it swirled away from Banton and he didn't even get a hand on it. Fullish and moving away, Connolly plays the slog across the line, gets it on the outer half of the bat and he escapes the mishit as the ball lands just wide of square leg outside the circle

Jofra Archer to Cooper Connolly, no run, zips through outside off, short of a good length, and moves away. The left-hander is surprised by the movement and is beaten as he pokes at it without any foot movement
Jofra Archer to Cooper Connolly, no run, stays on the back foot and defends into the pitch
Gus Atkinson to Mitchell Marsh, 2 runs, shimmies down the track to this length delivery and also moves back slightly and lofts it towards cover for a brace. Doesn't quite get the timing right, though
Gus Atkinson to Mitchell Marsh, no run, in that channel around off, Mitchell Marsh defends off the back foot

Gus Atkinson to Mitchell Marsh, SIX, goes hard, doesn't exactly middle the slog but he slogged hard enough to clear the wide long-on fence. Fullish delivery, Marsh cleared his front leg out of the way and hit it all the way
Gus Atkinson to Mitchell Marsh, no run, short of length delivery nipping back in, Marsh looks to defend, ball hits the thigh pad and rolls to slip

Gus Atkinson to Mitchell Marsh, FOUR, smashed through cover! Just stepped out and absolutely muscled this full ball through cover and even held the pose. Would have been so tough to stop the ball had it been straight to the fielder

Gus Atkinson to Mitchell Marsh, byes, FOUR, oh inside edge escapes the off stump and Jordan Cox. Fullish and nipping back in, Marsh looked to defend. Ball took the inside edge or was it the thigh pad. There is wave when the ball passed the back leg so it's not off the bat. Gus Atkinson thought there was bat and got excited for a bit. Cox dived to the left. Interestingly, byes given despite clear evidence
Jamie Overton, right-arm fast, comes into the attack

Jamie Overton to Cooper Connolly, 3 runs, drops it short, and the left-hander gets a top edge on the pull. The ball travels towards deep mid-wicket and doesn't have enough legs to reach the boundary, but there's plenty of time for the batters to come back for three
Jamie Overton to Mitchell Marsh, no run, short of length delivery moving away, Marsh plays inside the line and misses

Jamie Overton to Mitchell Marsh, 2 runs, this is high but there is no deep mid-wicket to swallow this. Shortish delivery, Marsh rocks back and looks to pull hard, mistimes and manages to clear the infield

Jamie Overton to Mitchell Marsh, SIX, and he's now whacked that over mid-on. Marsh is no mood to calm down. Ran down the pitch, forced Overton to drop it short but he still managed to flat-bat the pull over long-on. Goes a long way into the stands as well
Brook has a chat with Overton

Jamie Overton to Mitchell Marsh, no run
